title: Text animations
summary: Typography with restraint: one short white word at a time in clean sans capitals — heavy and wide, or tall and condensed — revealed letter by letter out of a soft blur, with hairlines and tiny tracked-out small print. Title cards stand in for footage with an out-of-focus field (sky, meadow, stone, dusk, noir or bone). The 19 ids are the same in every theme, so a storyboard can switch themes.
usage: Title cards fill the frame (any shape from square to 9:16): use one as a shot's "background" (a candidate may then omit "visual"), as its "visual", or as a footage "cutaway", e.g. {"background": {"piece": "text/headline-slam", "props": {"lines": ["NEW", "SEASON"], "field": "stone"}}}. Overlays are see-through, in 1080×1920 frame pixels: {"piece": "text/keyword-slam", "start": 1.2, "end": 2.4, "props": {"word": "Effortless", "y": 330, "face": "wide"}}. Every word and position is a prop; "field" picks the ground of a title card, "face" (wide or tall) the voice of a word, "accent" (poppy, cobalt, sun or white) the one colour; overlays dim away when given "life". Kit: library/themes/fashion/kit.js. Files: library/themes/fashion/text/pieces/.

items.name: Headline
items.description: One to three short lines in the middle of an out-of-focus field, revealed letter by letter out of blur; small print above, a short accent hairline below, tiny labels in the corners.

items.name: Split stack
items.description: Two words in the theme’s two voices on a clean card over the blurred field: tall condensed above a hairline, heavy caps below.

items.name: Marquee wall
items.description: Rows of heavy caps crossing slowly in alternate directions as hairline outlines; only the middle row is solid.

items.name: Statement
items.description: One sentence whose words fade up out of blur one after another; the emphasised words get the accent hairline.

items.name: Big number
items.description: Thin tall numerals that count up in the middle of the field, with the unit typed on in heavy caps under one hairline.

items.name: Quote card
items.description: A quotation set like a film title card between two short hairlines, credited in small print.

items.name: Agenda
items.description: A running order set like film credits: thin numerals, caps and hairlines, one row at a time.

items.name: Versus
items.description: Two options as the theme’s vertical panels sliding in from opposite ends, a condensed word in each, a small ring between.

items.name: Chapter
items.description: A clean card opens over the blurred field holding a thin tall numeral; the chapter title is typed on beneath.

items.name: Countdown
items.description: Thin numerals come up out of blur one after another inside a hairline ring, then the go word is typed on.

items.name: End card
items.description: The close on near-black: a ring draws with one accent dot, the lines are typed on, the call to action sits in small print.

items.name: The word
items.description: THE word: one short white word on the footage, typed on letter by letter out of blur in heavy caps, or (face: tall) condensed with its tracking closing up.

items.name: Underlined phrase
items.description: A short phrase in caps whose words fade up one after another; the marked words get the accent hairline.

items.name: Credit
items.description: A name set like a film credit beside a short accent hairline, with the role in small print.

items.name: Edge marking
items.description: Small print running up the side of the frame along a hairline, like the edge of a film strip.

items.name: Ticker
items.description: Two hairlines open across the frame and small tracked-out caps travel between them.

items.name: Slate
items.description: Small print in the four corners, each behind a registration cross.

items.name: Window frame
items.description: Open corner ticks and a soft shadow around a picture-in-picture window, labelled in small print.

items.name: Seal
items.description: A hairline ring with small print running round it and a condensed word in the middle.
